Vin’s Holdings Ltd ( (SG:VIN) ) just unveiled an update.

Vin’s Motor Pte. Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary of Vin’s Holdings Ltd, has entered into a joint venture and shareholders’ agreement with Singapore-based Volt Auto Pte. Ltd to form Volt Auto B&P Pte. Ltd, each holding 50% of the new entity. Volt Auto is the exclusive importer and distributor of Dongfeng electric motor vehicles in Singapore and Malaysia, positioning the joint venture squarely in the fast-expanding EV ecosystem.

The newly incorporated Volt Auto B&P Pte. Ltd in Singapore will serve as the authorised workshop for Dongfeng vehicles, providing accident repair, insurance claims processing, servicing, diagnostics and warranty support. With an initial paid-up capital of S$200,000 funded from internal resources, the venture is not expected to materially impact Vin’s Holdings’ current-year earnings but is intended to generate recurring aftersales and insurance income from a growing electric vehicle population.

The joint venture leverages Vin’s existing workshop capacity, technical staff and insurer relationships, limiting incremental capital outlay while strengthening its role as an integrated automotive solutions provider across the vehicle ownership cycle. The move complements Vin’s earlier appointment as an authorised channel partner for Dongfeng’s EV line-up and enhances its strategic positioning in the regional EV service and support market, while the JV will be accounted for as a jointly controlled entity rather than a subsidiary.

More about Vin’s Holdings Ltd

Vin’s Holdings Ltd, incorporated in the Cayman Islands, operates in the automotive sector through its subsidiaries, including Vin’s Motor Pte. Ltd. The Group focuses on integrated automotive solutions in Singapore, combining vehicle sales support with aftersales services such as workshop operations, servicing, repairs and insurance claims, with a growing emphasis on electric vehicles through its partnership with Dongfeng.

Stearman Resources, Inc. ( (TSE:STMN) ) just unveiled an announcement.

UraniumX Discovery Corp. has deployed $3.83 million in cash to its Athabasca Basin mineral properties over the nine months ended May 31, 2026, with most of the spending directed to its flagship Murphy Lake project. The company expanded its 2026 Murphy Lake diamond drill program from 2,500 to 4,092 metres across nine holes after encouraging core observations, intersecting anomalous radioactivity in most target areas and extending the Murphy Lake South Trend to about 1.3 kilometres, with assay results still pending.

To conserve its treasury and focus on Murphy Lake, UraniumX has structured option agreements on its non-core Zoo Bay and NeoCore properties, under which partners could fund up to $7.25 million in exploration and provide $900,000 in cash plus shares of two listed issuers. This partner-funded model, combined with advancing work at Murphy Lake, is intended to strengthen the company’s exploration pipeline and leverage third-party capital while maintaining exposure to potential discoveries across its Athabasca Basin portfolio.

More about Stearman Resources, Inc.

UraniumX Discovery Corp. is a Vancouver-based mineral exploration company focused on uranium projects in Canada’s Athabasca Basin, one of the world’s premier uranium districts. Its flagship asset is the Murphy Lake property, located near notable uranium deposits and zones operated by IsoEnergy Ltd. and Cameco Corporation, positioning the company within a highly prospective regional corridor.

The latest announcement is out from Jura Energy ( (TSE:JEC) ).

Jura Energy Corporation has completed the Maru-3 development well in the Pirkoh Limestone formation within Pakistan’s Maru Lease, achieving initial test flows of about 1.02 MMcf/d of conventional natural gas at an average wellhead pressure of 105 psi. The well, drilled to a depth of 951 metres, has been tied into existing facilities and is currently producing roughly 0.7 MMcf/d, underscoring Jura’s role as a minority partner with a 10.66% working interest in the lease operated by Oil and Gas Development Company Limited.

Located across the Rahim Yar Khan and Ghotki districts, the 15.41-square-kilometre Maru Lease adds incremental production to Jura’s Pakistani asset base and supports its broader growth strategy in the region’s gas sector. The company expects production from Maru-3 to rise following a planned production build-up survey and acid stimulation in late 2026, a development that could modestly enhance its reserves profile and cash flow from its Pakistani operations.

More about Jura Energy

Jura Energy Corporation is an international oil and gas company focused on the exploration, development and production of petroleum and natural gas properties in Pakistan. Based in Calgary and listed on the TSX Venture Exchange under the symbol JEC, Jura operates in Pakistan through its subsidiaries Frontier Holdings Limited and Spud Energy Pty Limited, with interests in various leases including the Maru Lease.
